title: Apply to Join Our Contractor Network | Genstone
metaDescription: Apply to Genstone's contractor network for investor, rental, REO and residential renovation work. Have your license, COI, workers' comp, W-9 and NDA ready.
h1: Apply to Join the Genstone Contractor Network
lede: Submit your information to be considered for project opportunities with Genstone Construction. Qualified contractors must meet applicable licensing, insurance, experience and compliance requirements. The application takes a few minutes if your documents are ready, and the review moves faster when every document is current, complete and issued to the same business name.

sections.body:
Before proceeding, make sure you have the necessary documents and are prepared to complete the application in one sitting. Detailed examples, external links and specific instructions are on the Pre-Application Checklist page. You'll need to upload:

- General contractor license
- Certificate of insurance
- Workers' compensation certificate or workers' comp waiver
- Completed current W-9
- Mutual non-disclosure agreement

Check that the business name matches across all five, that the license and insurance are current, and that every page is complete and readable.

Genstone reviews your licensing, insurance, experience and compliance information. Approved contractors complete screening and onboarding, which covers how Genstone scopes, work orders, documentation, inspections, lien waivers and draws work. From there, you're presented with project opportunities that match your location and capabilities, and in many cases you can choose which ones to bid on.

Work available through the network ranges from kitchen and bath renovations to rental turns, larger rehabs, additions and full-property renovations for investors, rental owners, REO clients and other residential owners. Approval doesn't commit Genstone to a set number of assignments. Opportunities depend on market demand, project requirements, location and contractor qualifications.

Keep your contact information current after you apply. If your license is renewed, your insurance policy rolls over or your business details change during review, send the updated document so your file stays complete.

Fill in the form below and upload your documents to be considered for the Genstone Contractor Network. Questions before you apply? Use the contact form and choose the contractor option, or call (312) 429-2637.
